# Vendored browser dependencies

These are the only third-party JavaScript runtime dependencies bundled by IMP-UX.02. The paths below remain inside this folder so it can be served as a standalone static site.

- **Three.js 0.186.0** — `three/`; MIT. License: `three/LICENSE`. The bundle contains only `three.module.js`, `three.core.js`, and the required FBX, NURBS, convex-geometry and buffer-geometry modules.
- **@dimforge/rapier3d-compat 0.20.0** — `rapier3d-compat/`; Apache-2.0. License: `rapier3d-compat/LICENSE`. The module and its WebAssembly companion stay together under `rapier3d-compat/dist/`.

The Codicons font is covered separately by the Monaco Editor notice in `assets/fonts/monaco-editor.LICENSE.txt`.
